# Dream Journal

## 2024-01-12

Weird dream about building a house made entirely of books. Each room was organized by topic - kitchen had cookbooks, bedroom had fiction, office had technical manuals.

When I tried to read any book, the words rearranged themselves into different stories. Frustrating but also fascinating.

Interpretation: Maybe reflects my desire for perfect organization of knowledge, but acceptance that information is fluid and interconnected?

## 2024-01-08

Dreamed I was teaching a class but couldn't remember what subject. Students kept asking questions I couldn't answer. Classic anxiety dream.

Woke up thinking about impostor syndrome. Even with experience, still feel like I'm figuring things out.

## 2024-01-03

Pleasant dream about walking through a library that extended infinitely in all directions. Every book I picked up was about something I had personally experienced.

There was a sense that all knowledge was already within me, just needed the right query to retrieve it.

This feels related to the Mnemosyne project - the idea that we already have the answers in our notes, we just need better tools to surface them.
